crew.overview: Inspired by her mom's rebellious past and a confident new friend, a shy 16-year-old publishes an anonymous zine calling out sexism at her school.
crew.title: Moxie

details.biography: Dylan Meyer (born December 4, 1987) is an American screenwriter and film producer. Her screenwriting credits include XOXO (2016) and Moxie (2021).  She has been married to actress Kristen Stewart since April 2025, with whom she started a film production company called Nevermind Pictures along with Maggie McLean. Her father is screenwriter Nicholas Meyer.
details.name: Dylan Meyer
